title: RAW UNREVIEWED: guarded privation versus plain negation in a shared bearer construction
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. A compiler distinguishing natural absence from loss of an expected faculty must preserve a bearer/stage qualification. This yields a different content consequence from an unqualified negative property, without choosing any Voynich faculty name. No target construction is presently bound.

design.production_mechanism: A source compiler condenses a qualified description of a bearer into a privative expression while retaining the condition under which the property should be present. The missing faculty alone does not determine the category. This is a proposed authoring transformation motivated by the complete primary distinction, not a native demonstration of abbreviation.
design.finite_construction: Let P(x) be an unnamed faculty and E(x,t) its eligibility at the stated stage. Guarded privation uses E(x,t) AND NOT P(x), while simple negation uses NOT P(x). Compare two explicitly qualified cases with the same absent faculty: E=0 versus E=1. The guarded reading distinguishes their classification; simple negation alone does not. No numeral, faculty, age word, segment or wrapper is assigned to a Voynich form.
design.unequal_consequence: An eligible and an explicitly ineligible bearer with the same absent property cannot both receive the same unqualified privation predicate under the guarded account. If the writing does classify them identically, this account fails unless a predeclared overt guard makes the propositions different; an invented silent guard is not a rescue. Mere absence of a written qualifier is not evidence of ineligibility.
design.positive_structure_used: Directed composition, whole-form residuals and entry context permit considering a lexicalized qualified predicate alongside an expanded construction. Known-family transfer does not establish new-stem transfer or the specific eligibility semantics. Reusable guards could accommodate frequent forms, but frequency is not evidence for their meaning.
design.target_status: UNBOUND. No located owned target construction with recoverable bearer and eligibility contrast is identified in this pass. IDEA555 owns f85r2 formal scope examples, but its HEAT/MOISTURE/OPPOSITE assignments are not inherited and its repetition alone supplies no eligibility contrast. Thus this RAW card does not authorize a target test.
design.smallest_next_step: If an already-admitted report-owned packet presents the same bearer/property in two explicitly differentiated contexts, retrieve whole-form profiles and assess whether one overt qualification can express eligibility across both. Draft only that qualified construction with unknown roots and the plain-negation rival; do not require a full translated paragraph, but do not manufacture eligible/ineligible cases from a picture or absent text. Without such a located construction, retain RAW and do not build a decoder.
